newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: UK interest rates need addressing soon - George.
newsitem.headline: UK interest rates need addressing soon - George.

text.p: The governor of the Bank of England Eddie George said the question of a rise in U.K. interest rates needed to addressed "reasonbly soon."

He told journalists on a visit to Lisbon that he exected inflation, currently running at 3.3 percent year-on-year, to dip towards the government's target of 2.5 percent during the course of next year. But inflation could then accelerate towards the end of 1997 under the impact of consumer demand.
